CustomField.description: The consent episode that authorized this thread. Set for SCI-gated Direct and Skill conversations only; null for response, lending, group, event, Vouch, organization, and moderator threads. The thread creator is always the episode recipient (Shared_To__c). Revoking the episode locks this thread. SetNull so right-to-be-forgotten deletion of a share is never blocked; a resulting orphan fails closed.
